entities.summary: Virginia Lugenia McLaurin was an American community volunteer, seamstress, manager of a laundry, farm worker, and a semi-supercentarian or supercentenarian, since her birth certificate was not located believed to have been born between 1909 and 1917. Such a fact is not unusual, as she was born under the Jim Crow Laws, as the public records at the time for Black and Native Americans were sometimes missing or inaccurate.
